'''Faerz Waleth''' was the manager of [[Sprawl 41]], a [[Nebula Consumables]]-owned floating ranch on the planet [[Tyed Kant]]. He was a friend of [[Sehn Baroule]], CEO of rival company [[Premier Provisions]]. When [[Droid/Legends|droids]] on Sprawl 41 began malfunctioning, Waleth at first suspected a group of strangers, actually [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] agents, who had visited recently were to blame. He later discovered this was due to the [[Mynock virus]].
